card.name: Repeat and frequency words in dosing
card.fires_on: Words that signal repetition or frequency in dosing directions, such as again, repeat, repeated, twice, and times. It also fires on small words like at least or at that follow them.

modes.label: Repeat wording
modes.description: The word repeat or repeated, or again, used for giving another dose.

modes.label: Counts of times
modes.description: Twice, ice, or times giving how often something is done or how many times to invert a bag.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of the model writing another repeat-type word right after, so the repetition idea is not said twice.
card.plain: It marks words in dosing text that say something is done again or a set number of times.
